elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an affiliate
elements.evidence: "Licensee may assign this Agreement, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate"

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: "or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets"

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent
elements.evidence: "Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent"

elements.element: Vendor-side consent standard: not to be unreasonably withheld
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: "and in no event to a competitor of Licensee"

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: "shall continue in full force and effect" (automatic termination and Licensor consent/deemed-reasonable-withholding language deleted)

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors with written notice
elements.evidence: "Licensee may assign ... to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets"; "Licensee shall notify Licensor in writing of such Change of Control within thirty (30) days"

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld (both directions)
elements.evidence: "without Licensor's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed"; "without Licensee's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld"

offending_extra_words: Otherwise, Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
reasons: Preferred level is fully satisfied: Customer affiliate/successor carve-out, Vendor consent gate with reasonableness standard, absolute competitor bar, and removal of the change-of-control auto-termination (replaced with notice).

Minimality fails: operation 1 expands 28 words to 93 (ratio 3.32) and changes 70% of characters; the affiliate/successor carve-out and Vendor-side restriction could have been added as concise insertions anchored on the retained sentence rather than a rewrite of it.
Operations 2-4 also exceed the 0.600 changed-character limit; the deletions could be anchored on larger unchanged spans.
'reorganization' and 'or delayed' add scope beyond the playbook position and are unnecessary to complete the preferred level (though they benefit Customer).

Intent is preserved: the Change of Control definition and the successors-and-permitted-assigns sentence remain effective, and no undefined term or dangling cross-reference is introduced (the stale Section 13.4(a) pointer was cleanly removed).
